note: Fitness (Dave 2026-10-21): a character attribute, a whole number min to max (-10 to +10), 0 an average adult, that directly sets how fast exertion rises during strenuous activity (running, climbing, tool work, heavy loads): the rise per second is multiplied by exp(-fitness x strength), so +10 fitness at strength 0.05 raises exertion at about 61 percent of the normal pace (winded after about 1.65 times as long) and -10 at about 165 percent. Falling (recovery) is not touched. It is stored with the character in characters.json like luck. New characters start at default. Training (Dave 2026-10-21: starts fixed, trains slowly): the creation value is the base; any physical effort trains it like a skill (Dave 2 Nov 2026): effort above min_effort (0.1) earns XP every tick_s (10 s) tick into the day's bucket (xp_today, saved with the character), paid out as points at game midnight, or at the next tick after login if midnight passed while away: xp_base (1) + xp_per_effort (2) x effort, so 1 at the line, 1.8 at a steady walk (effort 0.4, was 0.5 before BUGLIST-001 BUG-005) and 3 at a run, up to max_effort; xp_per_point (1000) XP make one point at every level, up to max_gain above the base (Dave 4 Nov, BUG-023). Walking alone is about 15 hours (14 before BUGLIST-001 BUG-005 lowered the walking effort to 0.4) from 0 to +10, running about 9. Effort between rest_effort (0.02) and min_effort neither earns nor costs. Only effort under rest_effort for more than rest_grace_s loses one point per decay_s_per_point (12 h), never below the base; sleep is neutral (Sonny 4 Nov: a night in bed is recovery, not idleness). Today's training shows on the Tab screen (protocol 92). set_fitness() sets the base and clears the training. Set strength to 0 to switch fitness off.
